data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue and pilot
data.body:
Hi,

JACOBS ASSET MANAGEMENT, LLC's most recent 13F for the period ended June 30, 2026 shows positions in AVBH and MYFW.

A recent public-record signal: AVBH entered into a material definitive agreement in an 8-K Item 1.01 filed August 27, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1443575/000143774926029104/avbh20260429_8k.htm).

I can share the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
